project_points: project 3D world-space vertices to pixel-space with optional camera distortion models
project_pinhole: project camera-space points to pixel-space using pinhole camera intrinsics
project_pinhole_distort_rt: project camera-space points to distorted pixel-space using radial-tangential distortion model
project_fisheye_distort: project camera-space points to distorted pixel-space using the fisheye distortion model
estimate_fisheye_fov: estimate the maximum field of view from fisheye distortion coefficients
